title: balance the scale: find the missing weight
seam: each pan: data-pan="left|right" with data-total="<sum of the weights on it>" kept current
each weight drawn on a pan: data-weight="<value>" (its number written on it)
the beam: data-beam with data-tilt="left|right|level" (the side that is DOWN) kept current; the drawing tilts the same way
the option weights to choose from: data-option="<value>"
brief: KIND: simulation. A two-pan balance: the heavier side goes down.

SCENE: a balance with a beam and two pans. For each item in order: the left pan holds item.left weights, the right pan holds item.right weights; below, the three option weights (item.options). Each weight shows its number.
The beam tilts by the TOTALS: heavier pan lower, equal totals level. It updates (with a smooth swing) whenever a weight is added or removed.

ACTIVITY: the child taps an option: it moves onto the right pan, the beam swings to the new totals, and -> Studio.answer({value: <that option>}). On a wrong verdict, after a moment, the weight goes back to the options. On correct: the beam rests level, a short celebration, then the next item. After the last: the done text and Studio.done().
antiPatterns: the beam tilting toward the lighter side
data-tilt not updated when a weight returns
the right option highlighted before the child chooses
